technical.summary: Strong trend structure (ADX 55.95) with bullish MACD crossover and momentum indicators rising, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, creating conflicting directional signals unsuitable for high-confidence swing entry.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 57 days create a low-conviction setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; fear sentiment (37/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and small-amount sales by junior members limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (342.6) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 57-day earnings window adds moderate event risk to discretionary sector already under stress.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX trend (55.95) with bullish MACD crossover and rising momentum provides technical structure for mean reversion entry near support (306.23) in a fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (342.6), price below all key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, zero fundamental conviction, high earnings risk in 57 days, and no triggered strategies create a hostile macro environment unsuitable for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows ADX strength (55.95) and bullish MACD crossover at support (306.23), offering mean reversion potential in fear-driven market. However, macro headwinds and fundamental weakness override tactical opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (342.6) combined with 57-day earnings event risk in Consumer Discretionary sector creates asymmetric downside; price below all key moving averages signals weak intermediate trend despite strong ADX.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
